title: Chunky, kinda ugly
text: Chunky, kinda ugly. These are heavy, chunky and thick. Looks like something you’d pick up at the thrift store for a dime. They are more a cafeteria style plate and lack elegance. I’d never use them for a special or more formal dinner because they are so ugly.
